$comment: Shared canonical-hash vectors. Both implementations must reproduce every canonical string and every hash below exactly. Read by the Node suite (apps/api-node/src/common/canonical/canonical-json.spec.ts) and by the Java port (task 5.3). Algorithm specified in docs/idempotency.md. Regenerate with tests/fixtures/.gen-canonical-hash-vectors.mjs.
algorithm: sha256(canonicalJson(body)) as lowercase hex; keys sorted recursively, no whitespace, integers only

vectors.name: empty-object
vectors.note: The degenerate case. Both implementations must agree even here.

vectors.name: flat-sorted
vectors.note: Already in order; the baseline the next vector is compared against.

vectors.name: flat-unsorted
vectors.note: Same content, different key order. MUST hash identically to flat-sorted — this is the entire purpose of canonicalisation.

vectors.name: nested-unsorted
vectors.note: Sorting is recursive, and applies inside objects nested in arrays.

vectors.name: array-order-preserved
vectors.note: Arrays are sequences. Reordering them is a genuinely different request and must NOT hash the same.

vectors.name: integers
vectors.note: Base 10, no plus sign, no decimal point. -0 would normalise to 0.

vectors.name: thai-address

shippingAddress.recipientName: สมชาย ใจดี
shippingAddress.line1: 123 ถนนสุขุมวิท
shippingAddress.city: กรุงเทพมหานคร
shippingAddress.province: กรุงเทพมหานคร

vectors.note: The realistic case, and the one that breaks a serialiser configured to escape non-ASCII. Must be raw UTF-8.
vectors.canonical: {"paymentMethod":"card","shippingAddress":{"city":"กรุงเทพมหานคร","country":"TH","line1":"123 ถนนสุขุมวิท","phone":"0812345678","postalCode":"10110","province":"กรุงเทพมหานคร","recipientName":"สมชาย ใจดี"}}

vectors.name: escapes
vectors.note: Only the RFC 8259 escapes, and the short forms where they exist.

vectors.name: control-character
vectors.note: A C0 control with no short form: \u0007, lowercase hex.

vectors.name: emoji-key-and-value
vectors.note: Outside the BMP, in a key as well as a value. Per-code-unit iteration would split the surrogate pair.

vectors.name: realistic-checkout

value.note: ฝากไว้หน้าบ้านได้เลยครับ

shippingAddress.recipientName: พิมพ์ชนก วงศ์สุวรรณ
shippingAddress.line1: 99/1 หมู่บ้านสวนหลวง

vectors.note: A whole CheckoutRequest as a client would actually send it.
vectors.canonical: {"note":"ฝากไว้หน้าบ้านได้เลยครับ","paymentMethod":"promptpay","shippingAddress":{"city":"เมือง","country":"TH","line1":"99/1 หมู่บ้านสวนหลวง","line2":"ซอย 5","phone":"0898765432","postalCode":"50000","province":"เชียงใหม่","recipientName":"พิมพ์ชนก วงศ์สุวรรณ"}}
